gt-reset-confirm: Reset ALL tracker progress for this game?
gt-missable-tip: Missable — belongs to Act-locked content. Once you leave the Act you can no longer earn it.

df-subtitle: All 188 RetroAchievements (929 points) for Neopets: The Darkest Faerie, split by Act in progression order. Items marked missable belong to Act-locked content — finish them before you leave the Act.
kp-note: Backs up / restores ALL Darkest Faerie tracker progress on this site as a JSON file.
kp-import-confirm: Importing will overwrite the saved progress of every tracker on this site with the file's contents. Continue?
kp-import-error: That file could not be read as a progress export.
note-act1: Act 1 side quests and items lock when Act 1 ends (after Escape the Castle). Treasure chests are safe — you can revisit Act 1 areas in Act 3.
note-act2: Act 2 is short. Everything missable here locks when Act 2 ends (after Escape From Faerieland).
note-act3: Act 3 is the largest Act. The point of no return is the quest “Into Meridell” — finish all side quests, treasures and items before starting it.
note-act4: Act 4 (Altador) is the finale. Nothing locks by Act transition, but wrap up Altador before the final confrontation.
note-global: Cumulative milestones earned across the whole game (NeoPoints on hand, Negg/clover bar upgrades, total chests, hoarding). Not individually missable, but they depend on the missable items in each Act.
